sections.text_helper: Section 19.7.13 "XSPI polling interval register (XSPI_PIR)" in chapter 19 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 539.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x090
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be modified only when BUSY = 0.
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 INTERVAL[15:0]: Polling interval
Number of CLK cycles between a read during the automatic status-polling phases

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.description: Polling interval Number of CLK cycles between a read during the automatic status-polling phases
